## load

```{r setup}
load("../DATA/data1.Rdata")

behrule = list(

    "AJ", "AK", "AL",

  rsp = c(

    "EJ", "EK", "EL",

  )
)
colnames = list(
  subid = "Subject", block = "Block", trial = "Trial",
  object = c("Object_1", "Object_2", "Object_3"),

source("./functions_plot.R")
```


## test

```{r}
dcay_td <- function(
    value0, 
    values,
    reward,
    params,
    system,
    ...
){
  
  list2env(list(...), envir = environment())
  
  # If you need extra information(...)
  # Column names may be lost(C++), indexes are recommended
  # e.g.
  # Trial  <- idinfo[3]
  # Frame  <- exinfo[1]
  # Action <- behave[1]
  
  zeta       <-  params[["zeta"]]
  bonus      <-  params[["bonus"]]
  
  decay <- values + zeta * (value0 - values)

  return(decay)
}
```

```{r}
multiRL.model <- multiRL::run_m(
  data = data[data[, "Subject"] == 1, ],
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,
  params = list(
    free = list(
      alpha = 0.6, 
      zeta = 0.1
    ),
    fixed = list(beta = 25, delta = 0),
    constant = list(Q0 = 0.33, reset = 0.33)
  ),
  priors = list(),
  funcs = list(dcay_func = dcay_td),
  settings = list(
    name = "TD",
    mode = "fitting",
    estimate = "MLE",
    policy = "on"
  )
)

multiRL.summary <- multiRL::summary(multiRL.model)
```

## create

```{r}
TD <- function(params){
  
  params <- list(
    free = list(
      alpha = params[1], 
      zeta = params[2]
    ),
    fixed = list(beta = 25, delta = 0),
    constant = list(Q0 = 0.33, reset = 0.33)
  )

  multiRL.model <- multiRL::run_m(
    data = data,
    behrule = behrule,
    colnames = colnames,
    params = params,
    funcs = funcs,
    priors = priors,
    settings = settings
  )
  
  assign(x = "multiRL.model", value = multiRL.model, envir = multiRL.env)
  return(.return_result(multiRL.model))
}

```

## recovery

```{r}
reticulate::use_condaenv(condaenv = "tf-gpu", required = TRUE)
```

```{r}
recovery <- multiRL::rcv_d(
  estimate = "ABC",
  algorithm = "NLOPT_GN_MLSL",
  
  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,

  models = list(TD),
  priors = list(
    list(
      alpha = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}, 
      zeta = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}
    )
  ),
  settings = list(list(name = "TD")),
  funcs = list(list(dcay_func = dcay_td)),
  
  lowers = list(c(0, 0)),
  uppers = list(c(1, 1)),
  control = list(
    core = 10, sample = 100, 
    # LBI
    iter = 100,
    # SBI
    train = 1000,
    # ABC
    reduction = "PCA", #ncomp = 6,
    # RNN
    info = c("Object_1", "Object_2", "Object_3", "Action", "SetSize"),
    loss = "MDN", L = 2, check = FALSE
  )
)

save(recovery, file = "../OUTPUT/recovery.TD(decay).Rdata")
```

```{r}
replay.recovery <- multiRL::rpl_e(
  result = recovery,

  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,
  
  models = list(TD),
  funcs = list(list(dcay_func = dcay_td)),
  settings = list(name = c("TD")),

  omit = c("data", "funcs")
)
  
save(replay.recovery, file = "../OUTPUT/replay.recovery.TD(decay).Rdata")

p <- plot(x = replay.recovery)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  plot = p$param[[1]]$alpha, filename = "../TD(decay)_alpha.png",
  width = 5, height = 5
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  plot = p$param[[1]]$zeta, filename = "../TD(decay)_zeta.png",
  width = 5, height = 5
)
rm(p)
```

## fitting

```{r}
fitting <- multiRL::fit_p(
  estimate = "MLE",
  algorithm = "NLOPT_GN_MLSL",
  
  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,

  models = list(TD),
  priors = list(
    list(
      alpha = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}, 
      beta = function(x) {stats::rexp(n = 1, rate = 0.1)},
      zeta = function(x) {stats::rbeta(n = 1, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2)}
    )
  ),
  settings = list(list(name = "TD")),
  funcs = list(list(dcay_func = dcay_td)),
  
  lowers = list(c(0, 0, 0)),
  uppers = list(c(1, 50, 1)),
  control = list(
    core = 10, sample = 100, 
    # LBI
    iter = 100,
    # SBI
    train = 1000,
    # ABC
    reduction = "PCA", #ncomp = 6,
    # RNN
    info = c("Object_1", "Object_2", "Object_3", "Action", "SetSize")
  )
)

save(fitting, file = "../OUTPUT/fitting.TD(decay).Rdata")
```

## replay

```{r}
replay.fitting <- multiRL::rpl_e(
  result = fitting,

  data = data,
  behrule = behrule,
  colnames = colnames,

  settings = list(name = c("TD")),

)
```

```{r}
#load("../OUTPUT/replay.fitting.TD(decay).Rdata")

data_fitting <- base::do.call(
  base::rbind,
  base::lapply(
    replay.fitting[[1]],
    function(subject) {
      subject[["multiRL.summary"]]@data
    }
  )
)

p <- extract_setsize_history(data_fitting)
plot_setsize_analysis(p)

ggplot2::ggsave(filename = "../SetSize_Effect_TD(decay).png", width = 8, height = 6)
rm(p)
```
